name: PS2 Asset Forge
summary: Compose seeded PS2-era game-asset candidates from a local CC0 source pool, with shared deterministic gameplay animation, optional local PS3-era render-preview polish, and explicit human-reviewed GLB export.
notes: The 291 catalog entries are curated reusable source parts, not newly generated outputs. The optional bloom, vignette, and grain profiles change viewport presentation only; they do not upgrade asset quality or the PS2 target claim. Only one memory-only preview exists at a time; automatic promotion and automatic variant retention are forbidden.
